note: Dinosaurs make everyone feel like a curious kid again. Let yourself wonder about something today just for fun; curiosity is a lovely way to lift the mood.

word.fact: The spikes on a Stegosaurus tail are nicknamed a “thagomizer”, a word that began as a joke in a Far Side cartoon by Gary Larson.

hue.name: Inland sea
hue.note: For much of the age of dinosaurs, sea levels were far higher than today and shallow seas covered large parts of the continents.
